entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Court made the following
Order:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public
Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are arraigned as accused
Nos.1 and 2 in S.C.No.263 of 2019 on the file of Senior Civil Judge Courts at Badvel, Ysr Kadapa
District.
3.
It is alleged that the accused No.1 has purchased the prohibited noxious food items from accused No.2 and that they were selling the same without license to the public.

4. It is submitted that though the petitioners are charged with the offence of purchasing noxious food items and selling them without permission, the police have registered the case and filed charge sheet in Badvel Urban Police Station in Crime No.111 of 2019 for the offences under Sections 188,
272, 273, 328 and Sections 57 & 58 r/w 26, 30 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Sanamala Siva Sujith Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the police do not have the jurisdiction to register the case under the provisions of Penal Code and that similar matters came up for consideration before this Court in the batch of quash petitions, which were decided by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch vide order dated 27.08.2018.
HN,J 6.

It is pertinent to note that, in the aforesaid common order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, a detailed analysis of the similar issues has been carried out and the proceedings against the petitioners therein were quashed.

In view of the same,
the proceedings against the present petitioners are also liable to be quashed in terms of the above said common order.

7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners herein/A1 and A2 in S.C.No.263 of 2019 on the file of Senior Civil Judge Court, Badvel, YSR Kadapa District.
